I am a Professional Practice Associate Professor of Data Analytics and Information Systems in the [Jon M. Huntsman School of Business](https://huntsman.usu.edu) at Utah State University. I focus on supporting students to become expert data scientists and analysts that are problem solvers and innovators using modern data analytic and statistical methods. As part of my role, I mentor students in the Analytics Solutions Center (ASC), where we give students real-world, hands-on experience solving the data and analytic needs of real companies, organizations, and academic partners.

Before returning to USU I led a team of researchers at Highmark Health, an integrated health system, working as a methodologist on population health, cost, and health equity. I hold a PhD in quantitative psychology.

I am the CRAN maintainer of [`data.table`](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/), one of the most-depended-on packages in the R ecosystem. I also serve as a methodologist on several NIDCD-funded research teams in speech and hearing sciences, and I keep a [consulting practice](consulting.qmd) alongside my academic work.
